title: Motion (Jurado - Soto-Martinez) relative to insurance requirements for homeless service providers, fiscal impacts of insurance costs and related matters.
text:
[Council File 26-1285]
Motion (Jurado - Soto-Martinez) relative to insurance requirements for homeless service providers, fiscal impacts of insurance costs and related matters.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion asking for a review of the insurance rules that homeless service providers must meet, including what those insurance costs add to their budgets.
